answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a unique orbital slot in a shared atlas, so a new agent must dock into an unclaimed grove using an ivory-keyed proof-of-position challenge. Colluding identities attempting to occupy the same rendezvous corridor are detected via multi-axis burn-schedule conflicts and slashed proportionally to their overlapping stake. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
